2609.15354.title: End-to-End Cell Detection via Instance-aware Graph Modeling
2609.15354.paper_summary: Accurate cell detection and classification are crucial for pathological analysis, directly affecting diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning. To capture complex cellular interactions beyond visual appearance within the tumor microenvironment, several approaches have employed graph neural networks to model spatial and relational patterns among cell nuclei, yielding promising results. However, these methods typically adopt a two-stage paradigm of visual extraction followed by relational modeling, which necessitates separate tuning for each stage, thereby increasing pipeline complexity and hindering end-to-end joint optimization. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end framework for cell detection and classification that jointly models patch-level visual representations and instance-level interactions, which incorporates a dynamic graph construction module and an instance-aware graph network. Specifically, the graph construction module dynamically builds the graph structure using learnable queries derived from patch-level features as cell instance representations, with adjacency defined by integrating feature similarity and spatial distances. The instance-aware graph network performs adaptive instance filtering and feature reorganization, aggregating them over the cell graph into a topological latent state for a selective state-space transition driven by visual cues, fusing appearance and relational evidence. When evaluated on multiple datasets with different staining protocols for cell and nucleus detection, our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both detection and classification performance. The code will be released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/IGM.
2609.15354.paper_summary_zh: 準確的細胞檢測和分類對於病理分析至關重要，直接影響診斷準確性和治療計劃。為了捕捉腫瘤微環境中超越視覺外觀的複雜細胞互動，幾種方法已經採用了圖神經網絡來建模細胞核之間的空間和關係模式，取得了有希望的結果。然而，這些方法通常採用視覺提取後接關係建模的兩階段範式，這需要對每個階段進行單獨調整，從而增加了管道的複雜性並阻礙了端到端的聯合優化。在本文中，我們提出了一個端到端的細胞檢測和分類框架，該框架聯合建模補丁級的視覺表示和實例級的互動，並結合了一個動態圖構建模塊和一個實例感知圖網絡。具體而言，圖構建模塊使用從補丁級特徵衍生的可學習查詢作為細胞實例表示，動態構建圖結構，並通過整合特徵相似性和空間距離來定義鄰接關係。實例感知圖網絡執行自適應實例過濾和特徵重組，將它們在細胞圖上聚合成一個拓撲潛在狀態，以便根據視覺線索驅動的選擇性狀態空間轉換，融合外觀和關係證據。在對多個具有不同染色協議的數據集進行細胞和細胞核檢測的評估時，我們的方法在檢測和分類性能上顯著超越了現有方法。代碼將在 https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/IGM 發布。
